adaptations.localChanges: Adapt native alert markup into a stateless HEEX API with explicit announcement semantics and caller-owned lifecycle.
Adapt avatar presentation into an initials-first HEEX fallback with caller-owned image loading.
Adapt passive badge variants into a closed noninteractive HEEX component contract.
Adapt button utility patterns to native HEEX button semantics, closed variants, and caller-owned activation.
Adapt card markup into composable semantic HEEX regions without assigning workflow behavior.
Adapt skeleton presentation into a decorative HEEX placeholder with a reduced-motion-safe snapshot.
Adapt native label presentation into a protected HEEX relationship primitive with explicit required and optional indicators.
Compose upstream-informed form presentation into a deterministic relationship-aware HEEX field boundary.
Extract visible descriptive form text into an escaped deterministic HEEX relationship fragment.
Render caller-owned validation messages as ordered escaped content with deterministic IDs and no live-region policy.
Compose caller-owned form errors into an ordinary linked summary without package-owned focus or announcement behavior.
Adapt native input presentation into a closed HEEX text-entry API with shared FormField relationships and caller-owned lifecycle.
Adapt native checkbox presentation into explicit boolean and repeated-value HEEX modes with deterministic field relationships.
Adapt native radio-group presentation into a validated HEEX fieldset with deterministic option identity and caller-owned selection.
Adapt switch track-and-thumb presentation onto the native boolean Checkbox HEEX contract without adding a second state model.
Adapt native select presentation into validated HEEX option and optgroup data with deterministic field relationships and ordinary browser submission.
Adapt the standards-based customizable-select structure and presentation into a capability-gated HEEX API over the exact visible native fallback.
Adapt native textarea presentation into a relationship-aware HEEX API with closed resize policy and progressive CSS content sizing.
Adapt slider presentation onto one native range input with deterministic field relationships and caller-owned value display.
Adapt task-progress presentation onto the native progress element with explicit naming, validated bounds, and caller-owned lifecycle.
Separate scalar measurement into a native meter API with validated threshold attributes and browser-owned zone semantics.
Add a native HEEX hr contract and an explicitly aria-hidden decorative mode while adapting the pinned semantic border token into isolated horizontal and vertical presentation.

Adapt the overflow presentation into one native HEEX scroll container with closed axes and sizes, explicit named focus policy, and capability-gated decorative edge masks without custom controls or scroll state.

Rename and adapt the upstream radio-based visual pattern into an honest native HEEX Radio Panels contract with deterministic relationships, ordinary form submission, complete-content fallback, and no tab roles or client state.

Adapt Accordion presentation onto deterministic native details and summary HEEX items with independent or progressively exclusive grouping, server-rendered open snapshots, and capability-gated motion without package state or JavaScript.

Adapt navigation presentation into a named native nav and list of real HEEX anchors with explicit current-location semantics, responsive closed layouts, and no menu roles, activation interception, route inference, or client router.
Adapt responsive header presentation into a native HEEX composition that preserves caller-owned brand, navigation, utilities, forms, headings, and actions without inventing behavior.
Extract a caller-heading-preserving section composition with static or sticky presentation, target decoration, normal-flow fallback, and no scroll observation.

Establish deterministic native overlay relationships and capability-gated top-layer, backdrop, bounded placement, motion, reduced-motion, and forced-color presentation without a package JavaScript runtime.

Adapt Dialog presentation to an initially closed native dialog with declarative invoker commands, deterministic relationships, closed dismissal and autofocus intent, explicit exit and fallback regions, and no package JavaScript.

Adapt Alert Dialog presentation to native alertdialog semantics with fixed close-request dismissal, least-destructive cancel autofocus, required consequence and caller-owned action regions, and no operation or outcome behavior.

Adapt Drawer presentation to a native modal with deterministic HEEX relationships, logical start/end/bottom edges, explicit focus and exit, bounded native body scrolling and ordinary route fallback without gestures or JavaScript.

Adapt native nonmodal Popover into deterministic HEEx with protected names and invoker actions, capability-gated implicit anchoring and ordered flips, readable centered fallback, and no state or positioning runtime.

Rename the visual dropdown adaptation to Dropdown Actions, composing auto Popover with stable keyed text-labelled native links and buttons, named groups, separators, protected native attributes and no ARIA menu or command runtime.

Adapt the plain CSS supplemental description into escaped text and a structured native trigger with stable merged description IDs, scoped optional anchors, normal-flow fallback, no delays and no interest invokers.

Replace emerging interest-invoker activation with supplemental CSS hover/focus-within, a complete text-labelled native link, constrained trusted presentation HEEx, scoped optional anchors and ordinary navigation without top-layer or loading behavior.
Namespace semantic tokens, prefix generated utilities, remove Preflight, add sRGB fallback, and scope theme and reduced-motion behavior.
